SELECT 
  fish_date_doy,
  cls,
  COUNT(*) as trips,
  SUM(yt) as total_yt,
  AVG(yt / NULLIF(anglers, 0)) as avg_yt_per_angler,
  MAX(yt / NULLIF(anglers, 0)) as peak_per_angler
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_doy >= 132 AND fish_date_season = 6
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY fish_date_doy DESC, avg_yt_per_angler DESC
LIMIT 50

SELECT DISTINCT
  fish_date_doy,
  fish_date_t,
  cls,
  boat,
  COUNT(*) as boat_appearances
FROM schedule
WHERE fish_date_doy BETWEEN 152 AND 160 AND fish_date_season = 6
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, fish_date_t, cls, boat
ORDER BY fish_date_doy, cls
